title: Advanced Vehicle Control Panel (AVCP)
message:

[hr][/hr]

[CENTER][SIZE=6][B]Welcome to Luna Mattins' Advanced Vehicle Control Panel (AVCP)![/B][/SIZE]

[ATTACH=full]1306540[/ATTACH][/CENTER]

[hr][/hr]

[B]AVCP is a modern reimagination of the existing BeamNG.drive web-ui that the devs stopped working on a while ago. It's a really cool concept, so I simply decided to make my own.[/B]

[hr][/hr]

[CENTER][SIZE=5][B][COLOR=#ff0000]!! READ THIS TO RUN !![/COLOR][/B][/SIZE][/CENTER]

To run AVCP, navigate to [B]Options -> User Interface -> "Enable Browser UI"[/B] and then open the "Options" tab again to start the server.

[ATTACH=full]1306040[/ATTACH]

Then navigate to [URL='http://localhost:8084/ui/webcontrolpanel/index.html']https://localhost:8084/ui/webcontrolpanel/index.html[/URL] in any browser on the same machine.
[I]Note; [U]http[/U] has been deprecated in v0.39, all traffic MUST be http[U][B]s[/B][/U]![/I]

[hr][/hr]
[I][SIZE=2]*Any green/blue accented screenshots where taken using a custom theme from V0.2 - rest is stock V0.1[/SIZE][/I]

[B]Running through BeamNG's external UI server, AVCP gives you a purpose-built telemetry, vehicle-control, world-control, AI/traffic, statistics, diagnostics, and credits dashboard, featuring:[/B]

[LIST]
[*][B]A Dashboard™️:[/B] Nice dashboards featuring live speedometers, tachometers, G-force meter, throttle / brake / clutch / steering bars, warning indicators, speed / RPM history, wheel telemetry, and raw telemetry.
[ATTACH=full]1306049[/ATTACH]

[*][B]Vehicle Controls:[/B] Featuring easy buttons to control recovery, repair, reset, reload, lights, signals, horn, ignition, shifting, spawn, replace, and removing vehicles.
[ATTACH=full]1306045[/ATTACH]

[*][B]World Controls:[/B] Time of day, time flow, simulation speed, gravity presets, camera modes, fog, clouds, and wind.
[ATTACH=full]1306044[/ATTACH]

[*][B]AI and Traffic Controls:[/B] Player AI mode, aggression, target speed, traffic activation, traffic spawning/removal, and traffic aggression.
[ATTACH=full]1306541[/ATTACH]

[*][B]Stupendous Thingies:[/B] We all need some fun these days, so AVCP features plenty of chaos too!

[*][B]Statistics:[/B] Top speed, max RPM, lateral/longitudinal G, 0-100 km/h timer, 0-60 mph timer, session distance, odometer, and vehicle details.
[ATTACH=full]1306538[/ATTACH]

[*][B]Wheel and DT info:[/B] Fixed read-only Lua queries for vehicle, environment, simulation, electrics, engine, and position information.
[ATTACH=full]1306542[/ATTACH]

[*][B]Suspension Stats:[/B] Live suspension stats, chassis load maps, damper activity and per corner load history.
[ATTACH=full]1306540[/ATTACH]

[*][B]Easy Customization:[/B] Effortlessly adjust the look of the entire UI through custom color themes and backgrounds with gorgeous glassmorphism.
[ATTACH=full]1306543[/ATTACH]
[/LIST]

[CENTER][I][B]And of course some credits :).[/B][/I]

[hr][/hr]

[SIZE=5][B]Mobile Support[/B][/SIZE]

AVCP also supports mobile devices!
To use AVCP on a mobile device, such as a phone or tablet, you must either expose your local 8084 port to your network [COLOR=#FF0000][B][NOT THE WORLD!!!!!!!][/B][/COLOR] and replace "localhost" with your machine's local IP address - or simply use Tailscale as I did.


Further photos of the app can be found below - as the forum only permits 10 attachments;
[URL]https://cdn.boykisser.cloud/malo-interactive/avcp/navtree.html/[/URL]

[B]AVCP is FULLY open-source and available on GitHub![/B]
[URL]https://github.com/Sanedish/avcp[/URL][/CENTER]
